methods.summary: The first evidence manifest saw only 18 files because porcelain collapsed the untracked x2 tree.
Explicit untracked-file enumeration recovered 319 pre-receipt evidence entries without replaying x2 execution.
The corrected enumerator failed closed on the new evidence recovery receipt because its validation prefix was absent from the first allowlist.
Adding only the owner-local evidence validation prefix produced 321 manifest entries with zero confirmed privacy hits.
